doc: Everything not listed is denied by ops/proxy/nginx.allowlist.conf. `pattern` is matched (JS RegExp, anchored) against the raw request path + query. Keep in sync with the nginx map; tests/security/methods.mjs and tests/exclusion/exclusion.test.mjs check both. Probe/expect are the unverified-until-CI expectations for the allowed-route check. `deny` is checked FIRST and beats every route (Session 4: restricted bundled assets that the open /src/ prefix would otherwise serve).

deny.reason: UCS Satellite Database, commercial status unknown = disabled
imaging sensor pack, commercial status unknown = disabled
CCTV ground heights, commercial status unknown = disabled (read from disk by the server, never needed over HTTP)
Bhote Koshi event pack CC BY-NC 4.0, mustNotShip (belt and braces: /events/ is no longer allowlisted at all)

routes.note: Session 4: /events/ removed, it holds only the Bhote Koshi pack (CC BY-NC, mustNotShip)

dev-server source is public by design (session3-findings #2); no secret may be in the image. Restricted bundled DATA files under /src/data/local_data/ are carved out by `deny`; restricted bundled CODE modules (bhoteKoshiFloodPath.js) cannot be, the app imports them at boot (session4 gap BK-1)

catalog METADATA only (name, lat/lon, sourceUrl); frame/media/stream are not allowlisted. Which packs appear is set by env (ops/deploy/gev-exclusion.env). Austin and Caltrans have no kill switch (session4 gap CCTV-NOSWITCH)

2026-11-24 (plan item 19a): military aircraft list, served by gev/server/providers/aircraft/adsb-lol.js from api.adsb.lol/v2/mil only (line 128); adsb.lol is allowed_per_doc and enabled in data/source-permissions.json. Exact pattern: /api/military/track (tracks.js also calls OpenSky) and /api/military-installations stay denied.

2026-11-24 (plan item 19b): wildfire perimeters. gev/server/providers/firePerimeters.js calls only services3.arcgis.com (NIFC WFIGS) and inciweb.wildfire.gov (lines 13, 92, 108); both are US public domain, allowed_per_doc and enabled. Exact paths: the perimeter list and the two InciWeb sub-routes the client uses.

2026-11-24 (plan item 19c): Salish Sea marine mammal sightings. gev/server/providers/acartia.js:7 calls only acartia.io/api/v1/sightings/current and answers only /sightings (line 157). Acartia is CC BY 4.0, allowed_per_doc, enabled. iNaturalist (restricted) is a different route and stays closed.
2026-11-24 (plan item 19c): European shipwrecks. gev/server/providers/shipwrecks.js calls only Wikidata SPARQL (CC0, line 44) and EMODnet (CC BY 4.0); both allowed_per_doc and enabled.

2026-11-24 (plan item 19c): elevation lookups. gev/server/providers/terrain.js:17 calls only terrain.reearth.land (Mapterhorn terrain CC BY 4.0, geoid EGM2008 public domain); allowed_per_doc, enabled. The restricted CCTV ground-heights asset stays denied by deny-cctv-ground-heights.

2026-11-23 (plan item 19): NHC and CPHC storm advisories. gev/server/providers/cyclones.js calls only nhc.noaa.gov and mapservices.weather.noaa.gov; NWS pages are public domain (weather.gov/disclaimer), allowed_per_doc, enabled.

RESOLVED session4: /api/weather/tile and /image fetch only NOAA nowCOAST (gev/server/providers/weather.js:4), never ECCC GeoMet. /api/weather-effects fetches Open-Meteo (gev/server/providers/regional/weather.js:16)

Session 4: /data/<id> limited to the 10 dataset entries whose permission is allowed_per_doc. Catalog route lists every entry (metadata) but GEV_LIBRARY_DISABLE makes GEV answer 403 operator-disabled for the rest
probe was gvp-holocene-volcanoes (Smithsonian non-commercial, restricted); replaced in session 4. 502 = upstream unreachable from CI, still proves the proxy let it through
